description: Canonical context-compaction policy shared across agent products (laintas_cli, Helpwo). Single source of truth for the KNOBS that drive compaction; each product implements the mechanism against its own message/history structure. Derived from opencode's strategy (packages/opencode/src/session/{compaction,overflow}.ts + packages/core/src/session/compaction.ts). Vendored into each product like tools/catalog.json. DO NOT edit the vendored copies — edit here and re-sync.

file_read_retention.description: Shared rules for retaining file-read content so the agent does not re-read files it already has (the re-read amnesia loop). Each product keeps its OWN per-path cache + file I/O; this only standardizes the BEHAVIOR. Modeled on Helpwo's fileViewStates.

notes.usable_tokens: window - max(max_output, buffer_tokens) — the budget the assembled prompt must fit under (opencode overflow.ts: usable()).
notes.keep_recent_tokens: token budget of the most-recent turns kept verbatim as the tail; clamp(usable*keep_recent_ratio, keep_recent_min, keep_recent_max) when not pinned (opencode preserveRecentBudget()).
notes.tail_turns: max recent user-turns considered for the tail; older turns become the head to summarize.
notes.prune: walk tool outputs backwards; protect the most-recent prune_protect_tokens and prune_protected_tools; truncate older completed tool outputs to tool_output_max_chars; only act when reclaimable > prune_minimum_tokens (opencode prune()).
